svg.text: Up to sixteen reflective IR channels on a shared pulsed LED bus, digitized on the board and read over SPI.
The two converters and the isolator board's connector
The isolator U3 sits on the isolator board, see isolator-board-schematic.svg.
SCK, MOSI and ADC-DOUT each run in two leads, one per converter,
and the isolator board joins each pair.
Channel n of sixteen, n = 1 … 16. All sixteen identical.
100 Ω on the three boards from the stock machine
Pin 1 supply, Pin 2 the phototransistor emitter,
Pin 3 the LED cathode. No ground runs to the sensor.
one switch for all sixteen emitters
Supply: 3.3 V from the D24V5F3 in its socket on this board; on the bench the Teensy’s 3V3 pin feeds the socket
3V3 to Pin 1 of every sensor board, and to U3
Ceramic 22 µF, X5R or X7R, 10 V or more, ≥ 11 µF at 3.3 V bias, radial MLCC
Ceramic 22 µF, X5R or X7R, 10 V or more, ≥ 11 µF at 3.3 V bias, radial MLCC
The boards on perfboard: variants/ir-board.svg and isolator-board.svg
